steps.name: The end of the crossroads
steps.objective: Talk to [Galet] in “Gerda” and complete the quest.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Adventurer, welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gallet, I'm sorry. We were planning to eat together, but we had urgent business to attend to.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: It's okay. It doesn’t matter when you come, please visit our folk story.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: It was truly an honor to host the continent’s best superhumans. Everyone said they felt empty and ate and drank without stopping.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: The food ingredients in the warehouse are disappearing like snow melting. Ah, I made a mistake.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: I'm from Gerda, and they say the snow is melting. If Io had heard, he would have been scolded.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Baldrick eats it really well, but I didn't know other people would eat it that well too. I wonder how many beer kegs Jiscard emptied with Baldrick… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … You two didn't get drunk and spar, right?

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Io said this in advance, so that didn't happen. He said, “I’m going to freeze you all to death hahaha.”

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Shinik, Io, and Medea were all really great. Adkina enjoyed it so much that she was thankful.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Don't worry too much. Because there is food left for Adventurer to eat.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Gallet. But are they all dead?

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Everyone left Gerda saying that they were full now. Oh, Miss Ren is staying to help. Did you go out with Frozen for a while? .

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Miss Ren... .

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Madeline, when did you come?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Just now.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: What brought you here? hungry? Do you want to go eat?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: It's nothing. I'm going right away. By the way, a galette would be comfortable. There are people who say they will help you.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: That's it.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Adventurer. Thank you for solving the Eastland problem. Thanks… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? I'm not the only one who did this.

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Many people asked me to pass it on to Adventurer when I see them. I'll be waiting for you, so come and eat Seolhwa's delicious food.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A lot of people? Superhumans?

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Yes, there are superhumans, there is Mr. Frozen, and there is a monk like Miss Ren... .

lines.speaker: 마들린
lines.text: Now that I've told you, I'll go. I think we'll have to stop them by having a snowball fight with frozen sardines in the snow field.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, Madeline. Goodbye.
Growling.
(Galet smiles brightly when he hears a happy sound from Adventurer who was seeing Madeleine off.)

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Hehe, it's my turn to step forward!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha, I guess I was really hungry.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Please wait a moment. Delicious food will be served in no time!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Gallet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…What’s going on? I guess I’ll have to go….)
